core_categories: Pharmaceutical Wholesale; Logistics; OTC Products; Medical Devices; Diagnostics; Own-label Wellness Products
specialty_focus: GEHE Pharma Handel is a major full-line pharmaceutical wholesaler and logistics provider in Germany, serving retail pharmacies, doctors, and hospitals with rapid, multiple-daily and emergency deliveries. It specializes in high-speed, secure supply chain execution, including emergency delivery within two hours, and supports community pharmacies through digital tools, marketing, and education. While it distributes medical devices and diagnostics, its core focus is pharmaceutical distribution, not wearable medical devices specifically.
key_brands: GEHE, Alliance Healthcare Deutschland, Alphega, gesund leben, others
